nodes.label: Captain Lysandra Ironveil
nodes.description: Lysandra returns to her hometown with the party and finds her father, a non-military man, wearing an old uniform and organizing the town's guards after a dire messenger arrived from Edge. She reads the alarming message aloud and recognizes the described slimy monsters, flying meat creatures, and changed eyes as the same threats the group fought back in Mirathorn. Torn between defending her hometown and heading north to Edge, she decides they must speak with the town leader, then explains their mission from Mirathorn to the shocked crowd at the inn. During the battle at the wall she uses her Commanding Shout to direct Karsemine, Bonogo, and Baergrom to fire at the flying monsters, and later leaps off the half wall in an incredible jump, missing one attack but following through to kill a second monster with a swift slice.

beats.title: Arrival at Mireward and news from Edge
beats.summary: A well-dressed man in an old military coat instructs guards to open the gate for the heroes; Lysandra is surprised to see her father in uniform. He explains a messenger from Edge warned of a siege by horrific monsters and that survivors left for Mireward Reach but never arrived, and the townspeople had grown complacent after a long peace.

beats.title: Lysandra weighs helping hometown or Edge, then heads to the Inn
beats.summary: Lysandra reads the message aloud; it matches the monsters they faced in Mirathorn. She debates whether to help her hometown or go north to Edge, and the group decides to speak with the town leader at the Inn, where a packed common room falls silent at one loud voice.

beats.title: Mayor Orik Tane addresses the crowd; six adventurers arrive
beats.summary: A well-dressed former merchant, Mayor Orik Tane, commands the crowd and says they have never received a message like this. The door swings open and six experienced adventurers enter, shocking the crowd—especially to see 'little' Lysandra among them. She explains their mission from Mirathorn and how they fought these monsters before, causing more concern rather than relief.

beats.title: Warning of shadows from the Reach; Stafl lights the road
beats.summary: Yelling and a bell ring outside; a scared boy says shadows are coming from the Reach to the north gate. Stafl casts Celestial Revelation, flies to the north gate, casts Light on a crossbow bolt and fires it down the road, revealing many shadows. A banging on the gate is followed by voices begging to be let in.

beats.title: Fifty survivors at the gate; ground rumbles with approaching forms
beats.summary: Ephanna rushes to the gate but protests letting the people in; the group numbers around fifty, far fewer than evacuated. A leader, Brin Holloway, a cook from Edge, says the town was surrounded and overrun by meat monsters. Before they can check everyone's eyes, Kasemine feels the ground rumble and spies multiple forms, some huge, approaching the town.

beats.title: Stafl's plan; Spike Growth and the monsters revealed
beats.summary: Stafl directs the survivors to the south gate and tells guards not to let them in until the town is secure. Bonogo scatters ball bearings and Karsemine casts Spike Growth in a 20-foot area. Large shadows enter the thorns and stop while others go around taking piercing damage. Within 120 feet Ephanna sees two giant tripod meat monsters, a golem-like creature, a swarm of flying meatwings, two meat hybrids, and two sewer monsters from Mirathorn.

beats.title: Tripods launch meat monsters; first kills traded
beats.summary: The 15-foot tripod creatures, bulbous and covered in skulls, launch parts of their bodies at the wall; both land short but transform into small meat monsters. Karsemine, Thrin and Bonogo make kills while Baergrom misses with his crossbow. The flying meat creatures take cold damage and fly out of the sphere. Stafl gives a potion with Bless to Bonogo and kills a flying creature. The golem remains in the sphere taking cold and acid damage.

beats.title: Caelynn's devastating lightning bolt
beats.summary: Magic and static electricity build along the wall. Caelynn, furious after the barrage, lines up and unleashes a devastating lightning bolt along the line of attackers, dealing massive damage to meatwings, a meat hybrid and a tripod. The recap closes asking whether it will turn the tide or Mireward Reach will be overrun.
